description: This PHP source file defines the ContactsParseRule class, which extends the BaseRule class. It implements parsing logic for contact-related panels in different views (DetailView and EditView) within a CRM system, transforming panel data based on specific patterns and rules.

classes.name: ContactsParseRule
classes.description: A class for parsing contact panels, modifying panel data during different view modes in the CRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method for the ContactsParseRule class. Currently does not perform any initialization.

methods.name: preParse
methods.description: Transforms panel data for the DetailView by replacing 'name' or 'last_name' entries with 'full_name'.

methods.name: parsePanels
methods.description: Transforms panel data for the EditView by replacing 'portal_password1' entries with a password input HTML snippet.
